errors.text_span: The Approximate Number Generation chart, also with four slices
errors.evidence: The Approximate Number Generation chart has three slices but is incorrectly stated to have four.
The Disjunctive slice is described incorrectly; it is light blue, not light purple.
The description does not mention the percentages as being inside the slices explicitly.
The description does not mention that there is no order based on size, which is present in the reference.
